reason: I was burned when I bought Jamku only for my staff to abandon it within two months, and I worry that connecting Google Drive will expose our private client records to an outside vendor. Until I see proof from trusted peers that our existing files are completely untouchable, I will not commit ₹12,990 upfront.
objection: Will connecting my Google Drive give Docketra access to read all my firm's private files?
would_change_my_mind: A live demonstration at my local ICAI study circle verifying that restricted drive.file scope cannot access existing firm folders, plus proof of sustained staff adoption.
